rationaleMd: Jardiance is indicated to improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus [1]. Jardiance is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in adults with heart failure [2]. The recommended dose of JARDIANCE is 10 mg once daily in the morning, taken with or without food [3].
